note: Live band 20 downlink, 796.0 MHz, recorded by sdrprobe at LTE's own 1.92 MS/s grid. Physical cell identity 28 (N_ID_1 9, N_ID_2 1), normal cyclic prefix, two antenna ports, 50 resource blocks -- a 10 MHz carrier. The receiver's tuning error is two whole subcarriers plus about -1.8 kHz, roughly -36 ppm at this frequency; the whole-subcarrier part is the thing a primary sequence cannot measure and the reason this capture spent a day decoding as cell 32. The frame number advances by six or seven per 68 ms block, which is what check-lte-dsp asserts.
